items.title: HP (HPQ) Names Emma Walmsley CEO as Bruce Broussard Becomes Board Chair
items.summary: HP (NYSE:HPQ) named former GSK chief Emma Walmsley as its next CEO, succeeding Bruce Broussard. Broussard will move from the chief executive role to become Chair of HP's Board as part of the transition. Walmsley brings prior CEO experience at GSK and currently serves on Microsoft's Board, adding big-cap and tech governance expertise. Emma Walmsley's move into the HP CEO role is a key leadership shift to weigh alongside the rest of our view. We have also spotted 2 warning signs (1 major)...

items.title: From cosmetics to drugs to PCs, Walmsley faces fresh outsider test at HP
items.summary: By Siddhi Mahatole and Bhanvi Satija Nov 5 (Reuters) - Emma Walmsley has said she wants people around her to challenge her thinking, even if that means disagreeing with her in front of colleagues.
